Name: DHG's drink
Author: hellofay
Description:
大家好我是DHG，这个系列是一些饮料，基本都要用到果酒。
哦有三款是咖啡。
这本来是一个为我的酒蒙子朋友制作的鸡尾酒系列，她喜欢花里胡哨的鸡尾酒。
现在酒蒙子很高兴，我也很高兴。
每个配方都有一定buff功效，希望你们也喜欢。
Hello everyone, I'm DHG. This series is all about drinks, mostly using fruit wine. 
Oh, and three of them are coffee-based. 
This was originally a cocktail series I made for my booze-loving friend—she loves fancy, over-the-top cocktails. 
Now the booze lover is happy, and so am I. 
Each recipe comes with a certain buff effect. Hope you like them too.
